title: Ecology SpeciesAreaIsland

stats.done_summary: Completed species–area relationship analysis using island_species.csv. Implemented code/run_analysis.py to fit OLS (lognormal), Poisson GLM, and Negative Binomial models; assessed Poisson overdispersion and 5-fold CV; generated 4 PNG figures in report/images and saved model summaries/tables in outputs/. Generated publication-style report/report.md via code/make_report.py with results tables, figures, and conservation implications (species remaining vs area remaining).
